policy.logoutScope: presented browser session cookies; independent devices keep their sessions

cookie.secure: enabled for a trusted TLS socket; omitted for the loopback HTTP development server

firebaseCompatibility.mode: SDK/API fixtures only; no real Firebase session revocation tested

verified: Exact 12-hour server boundary; repeated reads do not renew the session
Copied expired/logged-out cookies rejected at protected HTTP endpoints
Successful re-login revokes the presented old cookie while failed login does not
Logout rejects GET/cross-origin attempts, is idempotent and survives database restart
Ambiguous cookies rejected for authentication and all their presented tokens revoked on logout
Password/PIN recovery revokes the target sessions and the different account cookie being cleared
HTTPS issue/delete Secure attributes and rejection of forged forwarded-proto as proof of TLS
Multiple tabs, back/forward restoration, unavailable verification and failed logout UI
limitations: Secure branch tested at handler level using an encrypted-socket fixture; browser tests use localhost HTTP
The absolute 12-hour policy and server-cookie revocation apply to local accounts; optional Firebase SDK mode is outside the new policy
UI notices server-side revocation on focus/visibility/pageshow or a visible-tab poll; all subsequent protected requests validate the server session
